# S1.22 — Land the eval framework (§5h.2; R-2.9.2): the complete `MetricDeclaration`, `OracleDeclaration`, experiment records, typed `n/a`, `MetricValue` payload, veto/headline constraints, registry bodies

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5h.2 (`R-2.9.2` — `MetricDeclaration`,
`OracleDeclaration`, `Factor`/`Design`/`Arm`/`PreRegistration`, outcome
classes, `n/a{reason}`, `measurement.metric.emitted`, `veto`) ·
ADR-0045/0046/0047 · CF-094 · CF-099 · T-LCD-15
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/026_S1.22__eval-framework.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.9.2**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.21` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all verification is the `cargo` suites)

## Summary
The evaluation framework lands its C0/Stage-1 contract: one complete
`MetricDeclaration` (the CF-094 supersession of three partial forms), the
`OracleDeclaration` taxonomy with its per-class obligations, the
experiment records the Stage-3 engine will consume, the six-class
outcome sum with derived `oracle_failure`, a first-class typed
`n/a{reason}` value, the `MetricValue` payload for
`measurement.metric.emitted`, and typed registry bodies for
`metric_declaration`/`validator`.

- **`hh-ontology::eval`** (new module — the single home for eval
  vocabulary, CC7):
  - Moved sums, re-exported from their old paths (CC8 — zero call-site
    breakage, `name()` aliases preserved): `OracleClass`,
    `LatticeValue`, `VerdictType`, `EvidenceKind` (← `hh-verification`),
    `ChargedTo` (← `hh-hir`), `ModelRole` (← `hh-compiler`).
  - New §5h.2 sums: `Dimension`, `MetricLevel`, `MetricValueType`,
    `Direction`, `ReplicateReducer`, `IntervalMethod`/
    `BootstrapPairedMethod`, `OutcomeClassPolicy` (capability /
    efficiency presets + `refusal_is_failure`), `MediationChannel`/
    `MediationRequirement`, `FactorKind`/`FactorLevel`/
    `FactorDeclaration`, `DesignKind`, `Pairing`, `SeedPolicy`.
  - Records with strict canonical codecs: `MetricValue` +
    `MetricValueKind` (`bool|decimal|verdict|vector|n/a{reason}`),
    `Design`, `PreRegistration`, `Arm`, `SearchBudgetRecord` (ppm
    allocation completeness), `Cell`, `RunOutcome`,
    `OracleDeclaration`, `EstimatorSelection`.
  - `derive_outcome_class` — `OracleFailure` precedes the stop-reason
    projection; the class is derived from ledger facts, never authored.
- **`hh-ontology::compliance::MetricDeclaration`** — extended in place
  to the full 19-member form (`applies_to_families`,
  `requires_capabilities`, `requires_mediation`,
  `admissible_granularities`, `oracle_classes_allowed`,
  `replicate_reducer`, `interval_method`, `outcome_class_policy`,
  `headline`, `veto`, `charged_to`, …); `Default` reproduces the
  superseded partial form; `validate()` refuses `EmptyName`,
  `NoClasses`, `NoDetectors`, `NoOracleClasses`,
  `HeadlineAdmitsNonDeterministic{,Detector}`, `VetoIsHeadline`,
  `CltForbiddenUnit`; `applicability`/`applicability_at` return typed
  `NaReason`s (class ∧ observability ∧ capabilities ∧ mediation ∧
  family); full `to_json`/`from_json` codec.
- **`hh-ontology::control::OutcomeClass`** — `+ oracle_failure` (the
  six-class closed sum, `oracle_failure` canonical spelling).
- **`hh-telemetry`** — `metric_emitted_payload` now emits the §5h.2
  `MetricValue` record (`{metric_ref, value, applies_to, oracle_ref,
  detector, confidence?, evidence_ref?}` — supersedes the §5h.1 partial
  shape); `ProcessMetric` rows carry `dimension`/`direction` and
  `declaration()` yields the complete form incl. the spec-named vetoes
  (`audit_completeness`, `duplicate_effect_count`).
- **`hh-secrets::metrics`** — `SecretMetric`/`MetricCharge`/interim
  `MetricLevel` retired; the four `secret_*` declarations are full
  `MetricDeclaration`s (`security` veto, `mediated(egress)`, charged to
  instrument, spec-canonical observability/oracle classes per §5g.3 §4).
- **`hh-registry`** — `RegistryRecord::MetricDeclaration` +
  `::Validator(OracleDeclaration)` variants; `has_stage1_schema` += 2;
  `body_json`/`record_from_json` delegate to the ontology codecs;
  `register` runs each declaration's own `validate()` as the admission
  gate; `calibration_ref` joins the snapshot-closure edge set.
- **`Arm::validate`** — `eval_budget` equality enforced by `version_id`
  equality (content-address equality is dimension-wise equality at the
  record layer — CF-099/CC9); `search_budget` complete-or-`unknown`
  (product-level only); `artifact_ref` sealed.

## Evidence
- `cargo build --workspace` — clean.
- `cargo test --workspace` — **78 suites green, 0 failures** —
  `hh-ontology` 72 lib + 8 acceptance, `hh-telemetry`, `hh-secrets`,
  `hh-registry` unit/store/acceptance included.
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` — 0 warnings.
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` — clean.
- `bash ~/agent-skills/skills/build-memory/scripts/check-build-memory.sh .`
  — clean.
- New eval unit tests (7/7): `oracle_failure` precedence, typed `n/a`
  codec (never 0), arm `declare_arm` preconditions, search-budget ppm
  completeness, oracle-declaration rules, outcome-policy defaults,
  moved-vocabulary spellings.
- AC-R-2.9.2-2/-3/-13 Stage-1 halves executable: every registered
  metric emits the full declaration; headline/veto constraints refuse
  at `validate` and at registry admission; `MetricValue` payload is
  strict-codec deterministic.

## Decisions
**ADR-0258** — one complete `MetricDeclaration` extended in place; the
`hh-ontology::eval` vocabulary home with re-exports; `MetricValue` as
the emitted payload; derived `oracle_failure`; `version_id` equality as
the arm budget constraint; `validator` registry bodies as
`OracleDeclaration`s; `Factor` axis vs `FactorDeclaration` split.
